title: workspace.task@1
description: A workspace's task (#1347): a record item with the fields a work source's work.item@1 reading gives, and what it is blocked by. It is entered with `deep workspace task`, finished when a work run lands its change on the workspace's main, and filed as an issue when the workspace moves to a repo; a run takes these as it takes a forge's issues. Only the core appends it.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

task.description: The task's number in the workspace, from 1 in the order tasks were entered.

step.description: Entered in the workspace; finished, its change on the workspace's main with a PASS covering it; or filed as an issue at a forge when the workspace moved to a repo.

x-closure.closed: a task is entered in its workspace, finishes there, and is filed once it moves to a repo
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

source_id.description: The task's ID: the workspace's id, `#` and its number.

link.description: Where the task lives: in the workspace, or the issue it was filed as.

body.description: A handle to the task's body, never its text inline.

items.description: One acceptance criterion, as you wrote it.

criteria.description: The task's acceptance criteria, in order.

role.description: Their role: the workspace is yours.

x-closure.closed: an author owns the workspace, collaborates on it, or is outside it
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this kind

authors.description: Everyone who wrote the task's text, each with their role.

updated.description: When the task was last written, as an ISO time.

items.description: A task of the same workspace this one is blocked by.

blocked_by.description: The tasks it is blocked by, by number.

issue.description: The issue it was filed as, or null while it is in the workspace alone.

commit.description: The workspace commit its PASS covered, now main's head, once it finished; else null.

kept.description: Main's head before it finished: the last version, kept a step back. Null until it finished.
